scope: All four frozen substantive citation claims, all four bibliography entries, the complete canonical publication source set, the closest-result comparison, the active user-library selection, and bibliography coverage were checked. Mathematical census data were also compared with the accepted exact summary to detect unsupported strengthening.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage claim freeze followed by sequential primary-source manual verification under the citation-check search protocol, using publisher, arXiv and Preprints full-text locators, the checksum-bound local source PDF, and final BibTeX/AUX/log consistency checks.
